findings.detail: Stored distribution_rate is 33.7511%, but source financial highlights imply 16.38 distributions per unit divided by 68.62 ending NAV, or 23.8706%.

rationale: F33 checks whether distribution_rate is within 0% to 30%. The raw filing's financial highlights show 2025 total distributions recorded of 16.38 per unit and ending NAV of 68.62, implying a source-derived distribution rate of 23.8706%, below the threshold. The flagged stored value of 33.7511% is therefore not supported by the source and appears overstated.
